question: Within 160 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant ahead of Elyria Arts Council, Elyria, OH toward North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.105078 41.367311)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.105078 41.367311)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.105078 41.367311)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.description: Sharpy's Subs provides the food for the bar next door, Scalpers.

[4].display_name: North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH
